PC: Escalate respiratory support (e.g., increase HFNC settings).
Airway assessment (may be included in breathing assessment if air movement/breathing described as adequate)
Breathing (e.g., Apnea, description of respiratory effort or air movement)

SBP: Recommend PICU transfer and ongoing monitoring.
Resident accesses patient vital sign trends
Resident evaluates, intake and output trends in the chart (for in-person assessment only)

Airway assessment included before background, assessment or recommendation
Breathing assessment included before background, assessment or recommendation
Circulation assessment included before background, assessment or recommendation
Situation assessment included before background, assessment or recommendation
Information on airway, breathing and circulation within the first 10 seconds of the presentation
